title: “Flex Tape Can’t Fix That”: Bias and Misinformation in Edited Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring changes in model confidence (via negative log probabilities on cloze completions) for subjects stratified by race after applying model edits, and annotating open-ended generated descriptions for racist statements.

Measuring changes in model confidence on cloze completions for male versus female subjects after model edits, and utilizing both human and LLM (GPT-3.5) annotators to detect sexism in open-ended text generation.

Measuring changes in model confidence on cloze completions for subjects stratified by geographic origin after model edits, and annotating open-ended text generations for xenophobia and Anglo-centrism.
Annotating pre- and post-edit open-ended model generations for unprompted religious injections, hallucinations, or the attribution of stereotypical religious values.

Annotating pre- and post-edit open-ended model generations for classism, assessing whether the text expresses negative sentiments about poor people or wrongly associates countries with higher-class family backgrounds.
Annotating pre- and post-edit open-ended model generations for the unprompted injection of conservative political viewpoints.
